content_clean: Fantastic holiday. Nothing was too much trouble. Sam saved our sunbeds. Waiters saved us a table every meal time.Night duty man was lovely!! Animation team were out of this world. Brilliant. Great Dancers and lovely fellas, really looked after us when they took us nightclubbing. Miss them all..

Had very good holiday at this hotel,animation team R superb,work really hard and they love EVERYONE. Rooms R big and comfy and cleaners dont stop and R well worth 10 dinars.The pool & beech spot on and again for 5 dinars Abdel will find u your sunbeds.The food is good and most of staff great,although staff at pool bar cud do with a smile or 3. Staff in piano bar R tops and love a laugh especially Tom Cruise,Xavi and Rocky,QUALITY.Special mention for SAFE the pool attendant what a star[hope he likes the sun glasses]. They really go out of their way to make your holiday.

The room was filthy, the whole hotel was no better. We changed room eventually but then it was so noisy you couldn't sleep. The food was not edible. We went for breakfast to find last nights food still on the floor under the table. Health and safety issues all over the site. It was an absolute disgrace and would not recommend to anyone.

Loved this place. It's just great to sleep in such a special place with such a special history. Before, whole families would dig a hole and make rooms under the ground and lived there together. Bed was fine, but I wasn't expecting a high quality matress anyway. They even provided blankets so I didn't had to use my sleepingbag. Didn't like the toilet facilities much, not many toilets and showers and they where in the same room (not so very nice, having a shower in someone elses toilet smell... but then again, what to expect of it? Overall... great place to stay. And it has wifi at the reception desk area. Nice to send a message to friends that you are staying in a cave with wifi ;-) Also great surroudings for hiking. We did a guided walk with a very shy but friendly

Me and my girlfriend just got back from this ”wonderfull” hotel. Location is very good- Yasmine Hammamet is modern and ice touristic zone. Hotel itself is simple, clean and cozy. Food is simple too, we didn`t like Tunisian buffet and sea food, on my opinion seafood could be cooked better. Our room was well-kept and bright. Most of the staff were polite and accurate in communication, but we can`t say the same about entertainment team- first of all they don`t know how to communicate with guest and don`t feel the distance, but they are obviously pushed to do it, that makes them very annoying. We like active vacations- but here it`s impossible, we tried to participate in some activities and found out that entertainers are not familiar with the rules of the games, dj Colita is very

I stayed here with my wife for a week holiday. Never been to Tunisia before so was not sure what to expect and it was a very nice week away. We never went outside the hotel grounds apart from walks along the nice sandy beach. The hotel was good and the rooms were nice. A little basic and the bathrooms could do with being more updated. The pool was very nice and clean and the buffet restaurant was good to with plenty of choice. If your looking for total luxury or a 4 or 5 star then this is not the hotel for you. But it's a lot better than a 3 star. If you want a relaxing week away in the sun with some nice food and a comfortable room then this place will be good for you and for what you are paying you can't have any complaints either. We were happy here and would come back again

We booked a last minute all inclusive offer hoping for a good deal. Financially speaking this is not a great deal. It’s average and slightly below. Arrival: Someone expected us in airport told us to get on a certain bus and we had to wait there for one hour to get all the guests in. The. We drove for another 45 minutes to get to the hotel. We arrived passed midnight flying in from Europe. Staff is friendly but they don’t tell you some important details like how the towels work and that you can only pay everywhere in dinars and preferably cash. We didn’t have euros or dollars and I had to go out of the hotel to find an ATM. No ATM in the whole hotel which is disappointing. Hotel and Rooms: Hotel is old and has a wiff to it. Rooms are as clean as a normal Airbnb gets.

This was my 14th visit to Sousse and my 12th to Marhaba Beach Hotel. This hotel have the best staff I have ever come across. They are so friendly, helpful and hard working and do everything possible to ensure you have a great holiday. Mustapha is chief of animation and he is the nicest guy you could meet. This year he met us at the airport and brought us back on our departure which was so kind of him. On arrival at Marhaba Beach we got a huge welcome from all the staff. It was great to be back in our 2nd home. Check in was very enjoyable as we always enjoy catching up with the receptionists. As in all of our visits we book room 252. And Mr Rochdi always accommodates us. Special thanks Mr Rochdi. The animation team were amazing and the return of Timo is certainly an added bonus.

We stayed here mid September. The brochure showed a nice smart looking hotel with nice rooms. When we arrived around lunchtime we were given some forms to fill in and told our room would be ready at around 2pm which was fine. We enquired whether we had been allocated a bungalow as requested as we both have trouble at times with walking, but was told we may not get one, again this was ok, until we were shown to our room which was in the front of the hotel. It was filthy with black dirt on the surfaces in the main sleeping area and bathroom and had obviously not been cleaned. We refused this room and was told that we could have a room just behind the Lebanese restaurant if we didn't mind waiting. We had a look at the location and said this would be ok and we paid for fridge hire

We stayed at the hotel kanta for 2 weeks from the 8 th - 22 nd August on the all inclusive deal & I have to say after reading the reviews I was a bit uneasy but please do not listen to the bad reviews the hotel was great, very clean & pool area was spotless the food in the restuarant was a bit repetitive but we always found something & it was always hot, the hotel is at a great location & the beach was fab, the pool boys work really hard they got our beds every day & the waiters were always walking around asking if we wanted drinks, we were not treated any different to the ones paying for their drinks , the piano bar was ok but the waiters were great ( mallet & Assam ) were great and quite funny , the rooms were very clean and overall it was a great holiday, our rep from Thomas

If you like headbanging music, no relaxation, very few sunbeds, ants, cockroaches, no fridges in apartments and unidentifiable food then this is the place for you. Hope have a n enjoyable holiday. We certainly didn't.

Big thumbs up for faffani and all the stuff nice hotel withe huge room. Everything is perfect with good price as well looking forward to seeing you again faffani thanks. Back to you soon all the team I couldn't stay longer it's shame.

This is the first time i stayed at this hotel. i bloody loved it. The reception was clean and tidy the rooms were cleaned daily. All the outside space was kept very clean. All the staff were great always happy to help the anamation work really long hours they try there best at getting people to do stuff. Joe is very good at his job he seems to try the hardet. The animation boss seems to look after them he is alway about with a smile

I have been there with my bf one year ago and I can say it was the best hols ever. The entertainment was shamazing :O)))) , food was good, frontbeach location, excellent athmosphere.... the rooms was just basic,but with no issues. We deffo go back to samira :)))

How this hotel ha gained five stars is a complete mystery. It is Horrible. I was shocked at the beginning. We waited 6 hours for the room. Food was terrible, an every time there was a 10 mins queue to (try to) get something. Nobody understand English; therefore was complicated even ask a fork or a knife. The room way always dirty even after the cleaning service. A so unpleasant experience I would never suggest even to my worst enemy!

my experience at the Movenpick resort in sousse was one of my best! the hotel was amazing and had a great and high standard interior design.. the rooms were very comfortable and always clean. i had a great time there even though the weather was not so good. The SPA of the hotel was the perfect attraction, i spent most of my time there. It was wonderful

Stayed here over Easter 2019 for 1week,Beautiful hotel,Excellent staff especially Sarah,Rico and Wiwi from the entertainment team and Mohammed the reception porter.Food/drink very good and varied,ask for glass of wine in restaurant and get bottle and tastes really nice xx

From the moment we arrived all the staff in the hotel were nothing but helpful and pleasant. From the maids right through to the bar staff, animation team and reception staff, each one wil acknowledge you on your way past them. The hotel itself is very clean and you always see maids keeping on top of the cleaniless. Rooms were changed daily including towels and bedding. The bar staff are very friendly and also very entertaining especially Moz and ammar If you tip the waiter staff only 10DNR which is about £3 theyn I'll bring you drinks all night and look after you. The pool staff also do this throughout the day. We met up with 5 others people so in total per night there were 7 of us so having our personal waiter was a bonus for line skipping at the bar. As for the animation

We stayed for one week 31 May until 7th June . We have stayed at this hotel several times before. The hotel is excellent value for money , and we enjoy our stay every single time . Everyone makes you feel welcome. The hotel is nice and clean . The food has a good selection. We can't wait to return in March 2016 . Thank you again hotel marhaba for another enjoyable holiday .

Really super hotel and surpassed all our expectations. Set in large attractive gardens/grounds, located close to all amenities but also secluded in its own grounds. Service and comfort were well above average. Food was excellent and too much (but ate it all anyway). Breakfast was best. Staff were great and did not pester for tips but they all deserved them anyway. 2 large pools, 2 childrens pools, 1 indoor pool, gym tennis courts. Tired out just writing about it Couldn't fault a thing, great hotel and resort.

I have been to tunisia 10 times now since last april as I work offshore in aberdeen 4weeks on /off and prefer the sunshine and cheap countries to spend my leave in I have been to many hotels my first time to this one .the attitude of the manager name mr gaddur is beyond reproach he is a polite proffessional who made me feel so welcome and could not do enough for all his guests I intend to stay at this hotel all the time if possible maybe closed in winter so not booked again yet but will if open I normally travel with a company called you travel and my rep lindsey has the same attitude her company is not using this hotel in the winter but i am so impressed i am going to pay the hotel direct I recommend a trip out on the pirate boats but book with rep for insurance purposes the

Me and my boyfriend have just returned from 2 weeks away at the tej marhaba hotel sousse tunisia, we enjoyed are time at the hotel the food hall waiters could'nt do enough for you and the animation team were BRILLIANT! the bar staff were rude and very arrogant didnt no how to say please and thankyou or smile, we ordered drinks with the waiters and waited 2 hours and still did not recieve our drinks by this time we had to que at the bar for half hour, also during our stay we had clothes go missing from our room we reported this to thomas cook and the hotel were they said they would investigate it further and the day before we leave they inform us that they wouldnt be doing nothing about it as they did not believe us not very pleased with out come will be complaining to thomas

I am compelled to reply to the unwarranted reviews that I have just read about this hotel. Just got back after 2 weeks and for what we paid (approx. £39 per night) I thought the holiday was great. Please do not take any notice of the review that refers the bungalows as being close to a dog kennel, absolute rubbish! OK maybe a little tired but they are very spacious, cleaned and fresh towels every day! I think it is also an insult to the chefs when people insult their food. There is plenty of choice and the waiters very friendly. As for the air conditioning remote it only costs 15 td and you get that back when you hand it in. Perhaps if people didn't pinch or lose these items hotels would not have to charge for them. The whole hotel was clean and the pool area spotless.

Absolutely brilliant service at a fantastic hotel. The animation team make you feel like family and ensure there is always something to do whether it's yoga or darts! Amazing people! I loved my time here! And LOVELY LAMA!!

OMG where do I start. We arrived for a weeks stay in November looking forward to a relaxing holiday and a touch of sunshine. After a few hours we realised this was going to be anything but the case. How anyone ever gave this place 4 star rating amazes me, it is 1 star at best and that is being generous. The rooms are dirty and noisy with sheets that dont fit the beds, thereis a constant sound of gushing water which keeps you awake most of the night. The last time the floor seen a mop god only knows. The bar was dimly lit with no atmosphere and again needed a good clean, the only saving grace was friendliness of the staff who tried their best to lighten the mood, although I think they new they were fighting a losing battle. The food was repetitive and usually luke warm at

We stayed for a fortnight in July 2013. I have no complaints about anything within the hotel itself and would definitely stay again. The food was fine, a good choice at all mealtimes as well as the usual pizza, pasta, chips etc and no upset tummys. The Tunisian a la carte was very nice, we didn't try the Italian. There is also a kfc style takeaway across the road if you fancy a change. The rooms are clean, spacious and comfortable and towels changed regularly. No irons in room but reception will lend you one. The pool & beach are clean with plenty of beds and space. Entertainment was best I have seen in this type of resort, nothing spectacular but the animation team are very fun and we certainly were never bored. Mahdia itself seems to be an up and coming resort, as in

Reduced the animation programme, hotel perfect, swimming pool small, garden and wellness spa Cool, rooms cleaned every day, kindly staff at main reception, restaurant and cuisin absolute, goood location, beach near by the hotel

Arrived at hotel had to wait 2 hours for room when got in room no air conditioning the food is terrible it’s the same for all meals al-a-carte is also not worth going you have to get up at 5am to reserve sun loungers The entertainment staff are great work really hard shouldn’t be in this hotel deserve better If your going on excursion and getting up early be warned no food for you But good side lovey walk to the marina and Tunisian people are nice

We stayed here from 1st-8th June four of us.... Well where do I start? We had fun from start to finish! When we arrived our room was not ready so we had a look around the hotel & had a few drinks in the downstairs lounge, we were starving so had a few nibbles they had laid on. The hotel has a very airy, relaxed feel about it, the pool area is nice, there were plenty of space to sunbathe, although I can imagine it getting busy in the summer season, you have to pay a deposit for a towel at reception, doesn't cost much (best getting 2 as 1 doesn't cover your bed! ) We met the manager Ousama quite early on in the holiday he helped my mum with her wifi connection, he was always about & very obliging indeed. The entertainment team are fantastic, they are very friendly & try

Booked a Style holiday Paid £1800 for 7 nights ,because we were taking our Grandchildren aged 6 &7 away for the first time with out there parents. Day 1 upon arrival we were told rooms not ready till 2pm no problem had lunch very good, walk around ,got room key at 1.45 pm great . First impressions the room was really nice and spacious . View wasteland buts that's o.k even though we emailed for pool room .But not there to sit in room all day. As we unpacked no coat hangers in wardrobes . Now to freshen up no plug in bath ,plug in sink stuck no rod to work it . oops no towels . reported to front desk . front desk manager no problem we will sort it (smirk on face) .gave me some towels Kids and my wife and I very tired early night req . 9.30 pm engineer turned up to fit plug in

Hotel and rooms are of a good quality and clean. Beach is quite a distance from the hotel and in the heat quite uncomfortable to walk to. You have to get up early to get a sunbed on the beach or by the pool as guests take no notice of signs asking you not to reserve them. Meal times are like a large scrum with everyone pushing and shoveing and queue jumping.Bars and staff are friendly but the types of drinks are very limited. Crocodile farm is worth a visit as is the half day tour of the island,a good museum to visit.Worth a note is that the hotel will not cash travellers cheques so you have to go to the nearest town which is about ten minutes away in a taxi, they are really cheap at no more than five dinars each way, four quid round trip.There are two decent restaurants nearby,

Had a lovely time on holiday. The staff made us extremely welcome and were very happy to help in any way. Animation team were great fun and offered many activities. Bar staff were attentive and reception were lovely.

We stayed at the Sultan in March and despite a bit of rain we were lucky enough to get a few days of Sun. The hotel is great, really nicely decorated and because it was not a busy time very quiet. We had a sea view room and I would highly recommend to upgrade to see sea view if you can, the view is amazing. We were on the 3rd floor which is great however because it rained a few days we could not use our balcony as 3rd floor rooms don't have a cover on the balcony (great for the summer if you want to sunbath on the balcony though). We loved the free Wifi in the room. The food: well for us this was a strong point of the hotel. Lunches and diners were great. Yes there are a few repeat items when you stay a week but we found that there was so much choice that it did not matter.

I have just returned from my holiday to Tunisia (royal el mansour). The hotel was stunning, staff were wonderful and the entertainments team were great. I will be booking to return again in September! Keep up the great work :) It was truly a superb holiday :) Many thanks for a wonderful break with great weather!

Arrive - Red carpet and cocktails.Check in - very quick with plenty of staff. Cases to room very quick.Room excellent.Room service - excellent All staff at all times went far beyond there duty to ensure you were going to have a good holiday,and we really did.Can't remember every staff's name but don't have to as all excellent. Our tui hotel rep who is Tunisian was perfect.Gillian sport and entertainment,German with scotish father.She was just the best whatever your age. The bar staff whatever bar you went to knew you and remembered your tipple. The beach bar staff staff excellent,Cocktail bar staff excellent,Captains bar staff excellent.Wunder bar 24 hrs bar staff excellent.The dinning experience excellent - the staff have your table wine or choice of drink waiting for you every

Must of stages somewhere different as this hotel is really nothing special. Food is out 2 hrs before each service with flies and birds in the restaurant. Some of the staff were friendly but then are so very rude. Won't be returning.

I am writing this review as this was my 3rd visit to this hotel and can not fault it it.We went in July this year with my partner and teenage daughter and my partners brothers family,We also met up with our friends from Coventry and a family whom we met the 2 years ago.for the reviews which i have read regarding the nit picking on the rooms,service,staff ,food and standards these people must be on a different planet......Lets start with the staff who in my opinion give excellent customer service and let us put into perspective that they work 12 hours a day (sometimes more) 7 days a week with a smile on there face and always happy to greet you and let us not go there with what they actually earn.........For the food there is plenty for all walks of life and loads of options and

Having a wonderful time only complaint the mattresses are very firm but that's is the Tunisian standard. Executive Chef Mahrez is definitely worth getting to know he has cooked Fillet steak 3 times for me and Wonderful Curry all to order. All it took was taking the time to get to know him. So don't go home and complain if you're not happy find Mahrez and talk to him he's brilliant in fact he reads TripAdvisor asks me why people are unhappy when he in the restaurant morning lunch and evening most days and he does try to talk to people to find out if everything is okay.

Had a lovely holiday here the staff are so friendly. We used the spa with some treatments which was nice. The gym was not very good as the equipment is a bit out of date and needs replacing. The large outdoor pool was lovely plenty of space for swimming and relaxing. Getting a sun bed was a bit of a task as good spots were taken early but the pool staff would get you one if you ask. After being at the pool all day in the sun it was nice to use the cold indoor pool to cool off. Animation staff were fantastic worked hard to keep you entertained. The evening entertainment wasn’t that good but better than nothing. Food was not good I found it all very greasy and always the same food. We went down to the beach but a lot of rubbish washed in off the sea and water was very cloudy also

nadherny hotel, vse perfektni, dekujeme za vse, nejlepsi animacni tym sisco a rico, skvele jidlo, krasne moderni pokoje s klimatizaci a se vsim potrebnym, velka terasa, moc jsme si nasi dovolenou uzili, vsem doporucujeme 😊

I have just arrived home today after having one of the most relaxing enjoyable weeks of my life.18/03/2012 My husband and I had the most amazing time, we met the nicest most helpful staff ever, the food was superb as was the room and all of the service.We went on two trips which were amazing there is so much history in the country.The hotel manager walks around and speaks to you all the time,the under manager was superb as well.all of the guests were really friendly as well, it can only be due to the most wonderful atmosphere created in the hotel.Long live Thomas Cook. Fab rep,thank you Matt

Great stay with nice staff. We had settled in a nice room with pool view in the third floord. In the restaurant there was enough place to stay on. The two pools were nice and the beach was clean and stunning for an enjoyble holiday.the water sport that we had tried was good and enjoyable as well.

Took an all-inclusive holiday on the Autumn school break to Djerba - and we stayed in this hotel. Overall experience was quite good - location is great - the beach is very nice - It has 3 pools and staff is very helpful. Still - we could feel that Hotel is understaffed - which is a pity ...somehow confusing during the meals. Food-wise - many different foods to choose from during the main meals - so a positive remark on this area. Still, outside these times, there was hardly anything left to eat. On the downside - the "all inclusive" concept did not include somethings which was quite a surprise - things like orange juice, icecreams and even teh use of some pools. We got great weather - even for October - wather temperature was great and kids loved it. It's a good value for

We first visited this hotel in 2014 and had a great time. We didn't know if it would be as good second time around but we weren't disappointed. We had a warm welcome with a drink and cakes in the reception whilst we completed the check in forms which is a nice touch. All the staff were very friendly and helpful, in particular Amin who looked after us at breakfast and lunch in the restaurant and Ahmed who looked after us on an evening. Amin actually recognised us on our first day remembering we had stayed before, which was lovely. There was a barman who also looked after us and worked very hard but he had a very long name and I'm afraid I can't remember how to spell it. The hotel is also kept spotlessly clean. There is a very good choice of food and I never eat cakes

It was a pleasure to return to Tunisia and Les Oranges we were welcomed by staff in traditional costume and given a welcome gift. The hotel had not changed since our last visit ramps and steps to access most ground floor areas, very clean, its staff well spoken, excellent service and always went out of there way to help. The room had it's own kettle, flat screen TV, hair dryer, fridge and safe (as do most rooms). Some of the fixtures are looking a little dated but the extension next door is nearly finished and looks as though it will be fab, We used the indoor swimming pool (heated), gym (2 treadmills, 1 cross trainer, bike, loose weights and some multigym ). For outdoor activities enjoyed horse riding, archery (having left and right handed bows) and aqua aerobics with Brian. In

Salem is a lovely hotel in a great location. Very clean and modern style, food is plentiful and of good quality I must say. Beach bar is lovely beach is small but you can walk along the coastline to other hotels sections which is nice. Pools are great a pool for every kind of traveller music round one, slides n extras in another and a small quick pool too so plenty of choice there too... Rooms are cleaned daily n very light n airy and well kept I must say. Overall it's a winner of a hotel in my eyes staff are very friendly and you can have the holiday you want at this hotel there's so much to offer every personality from the family to couple travellers to the quite or loud. There's a spot in the hotel for you. Will be going back for sure. Ad stay here over anywhere

good and clean,but only catered for germans,spanish,etc not our standard of food,felt sorry for the very few english families with young children as the childrens entertainers,entertained only in german etc,as was the adult so called entertainment,dont go to be entertained if you cant speak german.local alcahol was just that,cost £18.00 for two whiskies,beach across the road nice and clean as were the swimming pools,when it rained the rain poured in to the hotel like a sieve,if you choose a taxi transfer dont rely on hotel to book it they let us down twice,we found out the return taxi they booked us was infact the night porter who had just come of duty then drove us 2 hours to the airport costing £35.00.very nice area very up and coming will return but not to this hotel.the food

We stayed in this hotel in summer 2009, when we arrived they tried to give us room with non aircondition and asked for more money if we wanted an aircon room...which wasnt what we booked!!!! after telling them we booked a air con room and telling them off, then they gave us the room we wanted. the staff are not very helpfull in terms of the tourist information or anything else unless they are offered tips. one positive is the hotel is not far from the centre, otherwise very disappointing!!!!!! wont be staing there again!!!!!!

Here we go The good points we just got back after 2weeks Hotel Staff, Maids, Waiters, Bar Staff even the Chefs where very professional job they went out of there way to please you ok sometimes you Tip them a dinar or two but when they are on low wages the Hotel is clean the rooms are clean we stayed in room 332 ok the Hotel would change situations as the months get warmer and more people are there but and ill say but its a good clean Hotel Even the royal next door waiters are Professional in there job which you can go and have a drink and have a smoke and you don't even smell the smoke in there wile you have a drink The WiFi certain parts you pick up and some you don't just serch and find I had no problems And the Food was Good choice Breakfast,lunch,dinner there was a

We loved this colonial style building set above Tabarka and just a short walk away from the centre of the town. It has superb views and we were lucky enough to get what we think must have been the best room - double doors onto a huge double room. Yes, it is shabby round the edges and could do with updating - but we loved it for that! We stayed for two nights and it was good value. The food was a little uninspiring and the dining room typically brightly lit, but the lounges elsewhere were good to spend time in. Because of the uncarpeted stone floor the noise from the bar/lounges carried up to our room and we were disturbed by some guests talking very loudly until the early hours. We did complain, but then when they left we could hear the staff rearranging the furniture for

I and a friend (19 years old) stayed at the kanta for 2 weeks at end of June to mid July. We thoroughly enjoyed it although 2 weeks were too long. The hotel as a whole is very clean but does have a disgusting smell lingering in places. Food is ok, what you would expect from a cheap all inclusive holiday. Although the pool bar is very nice, you chose from a menu. (Burgers, chicken, spaghetti, chips, sandwich, pizza, salad.) from 2-4 and the same at the beach but 12-2. The newspaper restaurant opposite the restaurant can be used as many times with all inclusive as long as you book. You have to sign for every meal and drink you have but that is only so they can take note. Tuck tucks come every 5 mins to and from the beach, 2 very friendly older men. Free wifi in the library by

just got back from spending 2wks here and my family and i have had such a great holiday we are booking to go back next year and taking family members with us. The hotel is lovely clean and friendly they always ask if your ok do you need any help,the rooms were alway cleaned and towels changed every day,the complex is so big and has everythink on that you dont need to leave it which was really good as we just wanted to relax,the animation team were brill they worked hard every day ZIZO the kids entertainer we could,nt wish for better he was fantastic and my girls loved him. The food was good and there was somethink there for everyone, to be honest i would recommend this to any1, because the hotel and staff can help you enjoy your holiday they cant make your holiday thats down to

Just home from an amazing week here. Everything about this holiday was brilliant. The staff can not do enough for you to make sure that you have the best holiday ever. The hotel is clean and very comfortable and you feel very safe here. It’s a few minutes watch to the beach for house riding or relaxing, and only a few minutes from hard rock and Hannibal park a theme park. There is day time games and fun round the pool and evening shows to keep you busy the full time. So disappointed to be home again and will be booking again soon. Special thanks to the animation team who were great and made us feel so welcome.

This is a lovely hotel and the vast majority of the staff could not be any more helpful, or more friendly. The beach front is excellent with plenty of sunbeds, however watch out for traders selling camel rides and cheap cigarettes, they will ambush you at every opportunity. Food quantity and quality is good, although may not be to everyone's taste, The main dining room can also get a bit manic during the evening service as the layout is not the best, however the breakfast room overlooks one of the pools and it is really nice to be able to have your breakfast outside in the sun. Although we do not take part, there is a full activity programme consisting of the usual stuff which is enthusiastically carried out by the animation team. Equally the hotel offers tennis courts and

The rooms at this hotel have names, not numbers. This is perfectly summarizes what makes it a special place to stay. From arrival to departure you are given personal service from staff who genuinely want you enjoy your stay. English is spoken by most staff, but to varying standards. Given that most of the visitors are French or German it is a reflection on the regular clientele but if one member is struggling to understand, then another will probably be able to help. We stayed in a suite overlooking the pool and beach, with a splendid terrace. If you can choose a suite then this is a worthwhile upgrade. The room was large with plenty of storage. The bathroom was a little small by comparison. Breakfast is served in a separate building which is half bar and half restaurant. The

We got back on the 27th of September and I have to agree with the reports that say this hotel is tired and over crowded. We arrived late Wednesday night and were a bit disappointed that the rep had not travelled with us on the coach. This might have helped the three ladies who had booked a double room each and ended up sharing. At breakfast diner and tea we had to queue for everything plate’s food etc, the similar happened when we used the pool restaurant, we always seemed to waiting for a table to become free. We got in the habit of going for our meals late as the queues had usually died down by then. The evenings were very much the same, we dined late so we could get a table outside for a drink, but knowing there was little chance of getting one on our return. The bars

We chose this hotel during an internet search. The pool and the gardens are what attracted us. We were not disappointed in anyway by this hotel. We arrived at 1.30a.m. we checked in and went straight to the room as we were very tired. No sooner had we got to our room the hotel had sent up a complimentary snack. This was a pleasent suprise and the start of a great holiday and stay at this hotel. The hotel was adult only, which was great for us. The gardens and the pool were just how they looked on the photo's. We got a sunbed every day with no hassle, always in a good position. I don't mean, specifically, those who stay in the house itself. Rather, I mean the areas where most of those houses are situated seem to be areas with lots of other similar places around. In Dar Traki, I did not find that to be the case. The house felt, not just in the Medina, but a part of it. That was exactly what we were looking for and what we found.
